build: The training build writes the model in a safe tensor format.
sign: A manifest listing every model file and its digest is signed, for example with the OpenSSF Model Signing specification.
provenance: Build provenance records what built the artefact, by what process and from which inputs, including the base model digest and dataset admissions.
thirdparty: A third-party model is pulled by digest, its publisher signature verified where offered, scanned for code-executing formats and re-hosted.
registry: The registry entry holds the digest, the signer identity, the provenance and the AIBOM link for each version.
verify: Serving admission control verifies signature, digests and provenance against the registry entry before any load.
serve: A verified model serves, and the verification writes an evidence record.
refused: A mismatch refuses the load and records which check failed.
